item.text:
`compat` plus `serde` builds and passes all 196 library tests, isolating F11 to the missing feature dependency rather than the compat implementation.

Latest feature-matrix results:

- `--features compat` alone: fails to compile (F11; three unresolved `serde` errors).
- `--features compat,serde`: 196 library tests pass.
- `--features storage-v2`: 194 library tests pass.
- Default, `single-term-leader`, `loosen-follower-log-revert`, and `generic-snapshot-data` suites remain green.
